integrity: All-size combinatorial proof and two standalone reproducibility programs are included; independently authored external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts only primitive temporal two-cycle orbits under ordinary conservative parallel chip-firing on S(K_n), n>=3; no claim about periods above two, all attractors, or transients. General cut-degree enumeration is known; new claim is a polynomial-operation compression for this graph family. Historical priority and external review are unsettled.
title: Polynomial-time two-cycle census on fully subdivided complete graphs
